name: Oran Es-Sénia (Ahmed Ben Bella) International Airport
before:
Oran's airport, 8.7 km south of the city near Es Senia, and the gateway to Algeria's second city.

Terminal 3 is the one that matters now. Opened by President Abdelmadjid Tebboune in June 2022, it covers 41,000 square metres with six air bridges and is built for 3.5 million passengers a year, extendable to 6 million, which takes the airport's total capacity to 5.5 million. It runs partly on its own photovoltaic panels and has two cargo hangars handling 15,000 tonnes a year.

Before that the airport worked from two buildings, the old terminal for international flights and what locals call the huge tent for domestic.

The runway 07R/25L, 9,843 feet long, has been in service since February 2009.

The site has wartime history. As La Sénia it was a French air force field, then Vichy controlled from 1940, and it was one of the primary objectives of the Allied assault on Oran during the Operation Torch landings of November 1942.
after:
The airport for Oran, Algeria's second city, 8.7 km south of the centre near Es Senia. It has two runways, of 3,600 and 3,000 metres.

As La Sénia it was a French airfield, taken by American forces on 9 November 1942 during the Operation Torch landings around Oran.

claims.note: Was 'it was one of the primary objectives of the Allied assault on Oran during the Operation Torch landings of November 1942'. The US Army's official history of the seizure of Oran describes the advance on La Sénia airfield and its capture at 1000 on 9 November by American light tanks and guns; Wikipedia gives the same date and hour. 'Primary objective' is Wikipedia's word alone, so the text says what happened instead.

claims.why: Wikipedia alone (inaugurated on 23 June 2022, it says), and nothing from the last 12 months says which terminal is in use. The operator's site given in Wikipedia's infobox (lesaeroportsdoran.dz) did not resolve (DNS error, one try; Wikipedia itself links an archived copy from 2023); TSA's and Algérie360's airport tag pages answered 404; Air Algérie's destination and Explore Algeria pages have no Oran page. The new terminal is the main thing an agent would want here: worth restoring when EGSA Oran or APS's 2022 report can be read.

claims.why: Held back: a new fact that replaces nothing. The UK CAA's 2025 table lists only Algiers among Algerian airports with passengers to or from the UK (Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted), in 2025 and in 2024, so UK clients reach Oran with a change of plane.
